verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs show an offboarding capability ('offload employees in batches' via the API), automated evidence collection for security awareness training, and identity-provider integrations, so it covers parts of the workforce-compliance story. The evidence never describes HR-system sync or onboarding/offboarding checklists that tie each hire to completed training and each leaver to revoked access. Missing for 10: HR/HRIS sync, per-person onboarding/offboarding checklists, documented proof of access removal on departure, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access
